app.title: Email Signature Editor
app.subtitle: Edit your HTML signature and copy it into Gmail

home.howItWorksSubtitle: Go from blank to a polished Gmail-ready signature in minutes — no design tools required.

items.title: Pick a template
items.description: Start from Modern, Minimal, or Compact layouts — or open the template editor to build your own.

items.title: Add your details
items.description: Fill in name, role, company, links, and image. Preview updates live as you type.

items.title: Copy into Gmail
items.description: Copy rich HTML for Gmail or the raw HTML string, then paste into your signature settings.

home.featuresSubtitle: A focused editor for professional email signatures — templates, preview, and copy tools in one place.

items.title: Template library
items.description: Built-in layouts plus saved custom templates you can duplicate and refine anytime.

items.title: Guided signature flow
items.description: Step-by-step wizard to choose a template, fill fields, and review before copying.

items.title: Live preview
items.description: See exactly how your signature will look before you paste it into your inbox.

items.title: HTML editor
items.description: Open the template editor for full control over markup, rows, and per-field styling.

items.title: Gmail-ready copy
items.description: Copy formatted HTML for Gmail or a plain HTML snippet for other clients.

items.title: Works in your browser
items.description: Signatures and templates stay on your device. Nine languages and light or dark theme.

home.templatesSubtitle: Three default templates ship with the app. Customize any of them or save your own.

templateDescriptions.default: Balanced layout with bold name and contact row — great for most teams.
templateDescriptions.minimal: Clean serif typography with a compact contact block.
templateDescriptions.compact: Dense single-block layout when you need maximum information in minimal space.

home.ctaSubtitle: Create your first signature now. No account required — everything runs locally in your browser.

signatures.fieldHint: Use Next to continue. You can change this later in advanced mode.
signatures.fieldHintDisclaimer: Press Review to see and copy your new signature.
signatures.reviewDescription: Preview your signature and copy it for Gmail.
signatures.librarySubtitle: Open a saved signature or create a new one.
signatures.chooseTemplateDescription: Pick a layout for your signature. You can change fields on the next steps.

templates.librarySubtitle: Browse layouts, duplicate any template to customize it, and save your own versions for signatures.
templates.emptyStateDescription: Duplicate a built-in layout to start editing and save it here.
templates.defaultSectionHint: Starter layouts included with the app.
templates.savedSectionHint: Your customized templates stored in this browser.
templates.cardHint: Click a card to open the editor, or use Duplicate to create an editable copy.

templateEditor.title: Template editor
templateEditor.subtitle: Adjust layout, typography, and fields — preview updates as you edit.
templateEditor.livePreviewHint: Sample data is used. Preview follows the app theme; pasted signatures adapt to Gmail or Outlook light/dark.

templateEditor.attributesHint: Defaults for image and text styling across the template.
templateEditor.rowsHint: Add rows and fields to define the layout. Drag the row handle to reorder rows; drag field chips within a row to reorder them.
templateEditor.fieldStyleHint: Override the template default text style for this field.
